subject.title: fix(browser): keep tab reachability retry delay abortable

question: Is the existing real-timer helper-level evidence sufficient to merge this three-line browser-route cancellation fix, or should the PR provide a managed-browser tab-mutation trace?
rationale: Repository policy normally requires real after-fix behavior evidence for external PRs, while the contributor has supplied focused production-helper timing data and requests an explicit proportionality decision rather than a code change.

options.title: Require route-level trace

options.body: Record a proof override if maintainers judge the public helper contract, existing regression coverage, and real-timer output sufficient for this isolated wait substitution.
